cause: Promise.all rejected on first cancelled child, so awaiting the aggregate did not guarantee every child cleanup had finished.
change: Retain individual child result promises and await allSettled for every child before parent cancellation returns.

strengthenedParentRegression.acceptance: Both real child containers are live before cancellation and stale detection; neither remains when parent completes; replay passes.

limitations: M2 live deployment, publication, downloads, release and demo gates remain open.
